subject: Acme DevWeek: co-host invite + RSVP funnel plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Acme Events <events@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme DevWeek: co-host invite + RSVP funnel plan

Hi team —

Following up from the call: Acme wants to co-host a 60-minute session during their DevWeek (target date May 15). We need to put together the inbound invite flow and tracking so we can get signups into HubSpot and feed the hotlist to SDRs. High level asks: 

- Finalize invite copy (two variants: technical + product)
- Segment recipients: Integrations engineers, Platform architects, CTOs (approx 2,400 total) — see attached seed list
- Set RSVP cadence: initial invite, 2 reminders (48h, 6h), and a calendar follow-up for registrants
- Link mapping: primary signup -> hubspot form (utm + source), fallback Zoom reg link if form fails

I attached the initial seed list and the co-host guidelines from Acme. Please review copy and the tracking rows in the CSV so we can hand to Growth Ops tomorrow.

Quick asks: 
- Naomi: approve subject line and ask cadence (do we want an extra 24h reminder for APAC?)
- Karthik: confirm audience splits and exclusion rules (we should suppress recent webinar attendees)
- Mateo: coordinate Zoom reg + co-host branding and confirm ACME will promote to their list

Attachments: invite-email-v2.docx (copy draft), audience-segmentation.csv, acme-cohost-guidelines.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Events <events@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme DevWeek: co-host invite + RSVP funnel plan

Thanks Marissa — good framing. A few quick edits and suggestions below.

1) Subject line: prefer "Build faster with inference at scale — Redwood + Acme" for the product variant; keep the technical subject short: "Accelerating LLM inference — patterns from Acme"
2) Cadence: go with initial invite + 48h reminder + 6h reminder. Add a single 24h APAC reminder only if APAC open rate < 10% on the first send (we'll use the first-hour open rate to decide).
3) Copy tone: technical variant should lead with a short customer outcome bullet ("reduced cost per inference by 35% at Acme"). Please surface the customer metric in the header.

Karthik — please confirm suppression window: I'd like 90 days for webinar suppression but allow 180 days for demo-led follow-ups.

Marissa — please update the copy and include the UTM string format we use for partner co-hosts. Once updated, loop me and I'll give final approval.

Zoom registration: https://zoom.us/registration/ABCDE12345?utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=acme_devweek
